messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

So we need to call it multiple times: one call for each duration with all companies. That would be 4 calls. The user wants to retrieve Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla for 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. So we can call get_stock_prices with companies ["Apple", "Microsoft", "Amazon", "Tesla"] and duration "1 week". Then again with "2 weeks", etc.
